column7: Angels are a significant part of God’s creation, serving as His messengers and agents to carry out His divine purposes. The Bible reveals a spiritual realm inhabited by these beings, who are powerful, intelligent, and obedient to God’s commands. Understanding their roles, classifications, and activities provides us with deeper insight into God’s plan and the unseen realities that surround us.
